instruction: You paid for a product from an online seller, but the seller stopped responding and you think it was a scam. Open the FTC Consumer Advice page in Microsoft Edge and use Immersive Reader to focus on the article. Find the `Report a Scam to the FTC` section, open the reporting page in a new tab, and leave that report page active.
gt_steps: Open the FTC Consumer Advice page `What To Do if You Were Scammed` in Microsoft Edge.
Use Immersive Reader to simplify the article and avoid distraction from the long list of payment-recovery options.
Find the final action section `Report a Scam to the FTC`.
Open the official ReportFraud.ftc.gov report page in a new tab.
Leave the ReportFraud.ftc.gov report page open in the active tab.
